text:
continue. Land CL57; the train's next step is the owner's own look: a question post asking him to open CL36's post on his phone and say whether the diagram reads right (he last tried this result on 11-24, CL36, CL38, CL39, CL40 and CL57 Done since).

## Holds
- **Check, rerun on `cl57` at 103a53e:** `KIT_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1 node kit/board/test_page_body.js`: **all passed**, 24 lines ok (phone and desktop).
- **Breaks, performed:** `git checkout <merge-base> -- kit/board/shim.js kit/board/board.template.html`, same check: **11 failed** (the 9 new CL36 checks, phone and desktop, plus the old "```mermaid draws as a diagram (2 edges)" check at both widths, whose selector now looks for the new graph). Restored; the worktree is clean. The check fails without the fix and passes with it.
- **What he asked, on the real thing** (CR-cl36: "the diagram is not this post's diagram"): I pulled CL36's post body from the board itself (identical byte for byte to `tests/fixtures/cl36_post_body.md`) and opened it on the kit's local board page at 390 px with touch and at 1280 px, light and dark. My own script measures what the test does not: each wire starts on its "from" box and ends on its "to" box, no wire runs through a third box, no boxes overlap, no box text and no table cell is cut (`scripts/review/CR-cl57-the-board-s-flowchart-draws-the-post-s-g-geometry.js`). Result, all four views: **6 boxes, each once; 5 wires, each 0 px from both its boxes (A>B, B>C, D>B, E>B, F>B); 0 wires through another box; 0 overlaps; 0 cut boxes; 0 page errors.** By eye: on the phone the four inputs sit 2 by 2 above "Post body", "Owner reads one place" below; on desktop left to right, the dashed "kit.py done refuses" edge dashed. The picture input E is there. Dark theme: wires and boxes readable.
- **Sampled claim 1, CL36's table at 390 px, 0 of 3 columns cut:** holds. 0 cells cut, the table does not scroll in its box, nothing wider than the page; the four-backtick cells show ```` ```mermaid ```` and ```` ```svg ```` as code, no stray backticks (seen on the screenshot).
- **Sampled claim 2, test suites 79 of 79 (`--all`):** **not reproduced here: 78 of 79.** `run_all_tests.py --all --keep-going` on `cl57`: 42 + 36 passed, 1 failed: `tests/test_install_present_runtimes.py` (`kit_brief_guard.py` not copied into the project's `.claude/hooks/kit/`). It fails the same on current `origin/main` (3564002), so it is not CL57's (an install/hooks matter on the trunk, likely from a step merged after CL57's run); it should be looked at on its own.
- One small thing on the phone: the label "kit.py done refuses" sits where the right-margin wire (from "```mermaid / ```svg block") and the short dashed wire from "docs/X.md" meet above "Post body", so on the phone it is not obvious which arrow the label belongs to, and the dashed stub is barely visible. Not a miss of the ask (every edge is there and connected), a polish point.
- `kit/claude/test_artifact_page.js`: the one-line change follows the new markup (`.kit-mmd-row` to `[data-edge]`), same strength, not loosened.
- **Not checked:** the published Artifact page by eye (same `shim.js`; its test ran in the suite and passed); a real phone; mermaid beyond flowcharts (the post says so: subgraph frames not drawn, sequence/gantt still code). The real-project run (Harmonize) is the orchestrator's, recorded in `real_project`; I did not rerun it (no Harmonize here).

## Goal
- The `cli` train serves: the owner never types in chat; the board (and the repo) is the one place a result is said, once, and he can read it there on his phone, pictures and diagrams included (K9). CL57 fixes the last visible defect CR-cl36 found in that: a post's diagram now is the post's graph. The measure (node and edge counts on CL36's own post) is the real thing, not a stand-in, and the owner's own example passed its bar, checked here on the body pulled from the board.
- **When the owner last tried it himself:** 11-24 (his comments under CL36 and CL38). He is on the board daily (5 comments 02:31 to 02:58 today, all on other matters: R5, ntfy, two orchestrators), but has not looked at a diagram in a post since. Five Dones on this train since his try: the next step is his look.
- **What the posts show together:** CR-cl36 found that CL39 and CL40 ended with the Harmonize run handed to the orchestrator and never recorded. CL57's `real_project` is recorded (Harmonize installed at 103a53e, 27/27), so this step closed that gap for itself; I did not recheck whether CL39/CL40's are recorded now. Also: the `--all` count in a post is a moment, not a fact: 79 of 79 at CL57's run, 78 of 79 on the trunk an hour later; a post's suite bar would be stronger with the commit it ran on.

## Verdict
**continue.** Every claim I sampled held on a rerun except the suite count, whose one failure is on the trunk, not in this step. Suggestion: land CL57, then put a question post for the owner: "Open CL36's post on your phone: does its diagram now show the 6 boxes and 5 arrows it describes?" (Yes / No, what's wrong), before more renderer work (subgraphs, other diagram kinds) is planned. Separately, the failing `test_install_present_runtimes.py` on main needs an owner among the running steps.
